content: SweetXml supports attribute-predicate matching directly in the xpath string, e.g. ~x".//statistics/ratings/ranks/rank[@name='boardgame']/@value"s to select a specific rank element by attribute. Because the value can be the literal string 'Not Ranked', it must be extracted with the 's' (string) modifier, not 'i' or 'f' (which would fail/return nil on non-numeric text) — normalize to integer or nil in Elixir after extraction.
